title: Island Continents
concept: Two broad opposing continents give each side room for a substantial land front. A deep channel separates them, so fleets carry units to exposed shores and create new landing fronts.
difference: Large, internally connected landmasses are the main battle spaces; the sea provides transport and flanking landings rather than a chain of small expansion islands.
routes: Ground forces move across each broad continent and contest inland approaches.
A continuous deep channel links both naval ports for fleet crossings.
The long north and south coasts offer alternate amphibious landing fronts.
economy: Keep home metal on both continents and spread expansion metal across inland ground and the contested channel.
visual_review: Reviewed the full-run contact sheet for seeds 1-10: two broad mirrored continents, clear central fleet channel, distinct land fronts and balanced resources.
core_wishes: Registry, gallery entry and watermark assignment by the core integration owner.
